notice_empty_hint.简体中文: 有新消息会显示在这里。
notice_empty_hint.繁體中文: 有新消息會顯示在這裡。
notice_empty_hint.English: New announcements will show up here.

notice_load_failed.简体中文: 公告获取失败，请检查网络后重试。
notice_load_failed.繁體中文: 公告取得失敗，請檢查網路後重試。
notice_load_failed.English: Could not load announcements. Check your network and try again.

notice_dialog_hint.简体中文: 点「全部已读」后，左侧栏的未读数字会清零。
notice_dialog_hint.繁體中文: 點「全部已讀」後，左側欄的未讀數字會歸零。
notice_dialog_hint.English: After you mark all as read, the unread number in the sidebar is cleared.

notice_dialog_more.简体中文: 还有 {n} 条未读公告，请到公告页查看。
notice_dialog_more.繁體中文: 還有 {n} 條未讀公告，請到公告頁查看。
notice_dialog_more.English: {n} more unread announcement(s) — open the Notice page to read them.
